page.layout: One printed page: running head across the top with page number at the right; below it a centred title "DE SERPENTE MARINO." over a large woodcut engraving of a sea serpent coiled in spirals; a line-number scale runs down the left margin (printed numbers 10 to 60 beside the image). A small signature mark sits at the lower right of the image.
page.notes: Page is an engraving of a sea serpent (woodcut, coiled spirals, head raised at upper left with open jaws). No running text is printed. The left margin carries a vertical scale of printed line numbers (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60); these are marginal numerals, transcribed here only as a note and not as text. Edge stains and show-through omitted.
